summary: Sync bundled activity and overlap checkers and raise worktree check timeout

delivery.outcome: Sync bundled ticket_activity.py and worktree_overlap_check.py with upstream new-project, deduplicate per-checkout git status calls and skip disjoint shared-default merge-tree invocations, and raise ConformanceRunner.check_worktrees timeout from 60s to 180s.
nonGoals: Changing worktree overlap or ticket activity policy semantics
Modifying release version metadata outside an integration ticket

architecture.decision: Update src/wellman/_bundled/ticket_activity.py and src/wellman/_bundled/worktree_overlap_check.py from upstream wellmanifest/new-project, compute unignored_dirty_paths once per checkout, short-circuit contested_paths merge-tree calls when shared_default is true and first_changes & second_changes is empty, and set timeout=180 in ConformanceRunner.check_worktrees.

validation.evidence: Bundled overlap checker skips disjoint shared-default merge-tree probes, fences checkout-local registration in ActivityReadBatch, and check_worktrees enforces timeout=180.
Governance gate and Wellman standards check pass with zero errors and clean git diff --check.
